how_to: Under 'labels' add "files/a/X/Y/Z": {"category": <one of hgss_labels.CATEGORIES>, "label": "...", "labeled_by": "name"} after looking at build/dau2/hgss_labeling/<container>.png (written by 'labels'); re-run 'labels' then 'matrix'.
